name: ExtremeLoto
rootCause: The attacker co****op launched continuous attacks on the EOS quiz game contract xlo*****io and has already profited hundreds of EOS. After preliminary analysis, the attacker used the logic defect of the game contract by directly invoking the transfer method, and multiple accounts coordinated to carry out the attack.
